My dryer died on me.  I got to tinkering and reading online about Youtube fixes for identical problem in my brand of dryer.  Looked simple to me, so I bought the inexpensive replacement door switch.  Well, lo and behold, this 70 year old woman fixed my own dryer!!!!  So easy to do.....the size of a dryer scares you, but when you open it up, there's hardly anything in it to mess with.  Took me about an hour because it was hard to get to my dryer in a small closet, but I did it.....I have reaffirmed my ability to do things usually reserved for the "man" in your life - well, when he's not here any more, you do what you have to!!!  So proud of myself and so glad the part was so cheap - Let's hear it for the girls.....!!!

This switch arrived fast, it allowed me to fix my flat electric stove top immediately and get one of the main burners back to use. Even though the product description didn't list my Fridgidaire stove/oven model it was easy to see it was right for it by the correct number of plugins the volts and amps and knob style. A repair company broke the flat top then replaced the whole top but burnt out the switch by not unplugging the whole unit before they replaced the top. So I had a burner that was only full hot and wouldn't cycle like it should've. It was a direct fit cheaper than anywhere, and quicker shipping. It beat buying a new stove like my ol' lady wanted to do....

One of the eyes on my stove stopped working.  There was power going to the switch but nothing coming out so I ordered this switch.  Unfortunately it didn't fix the problem.  It turned out to be the simmer circuit.  I  bypassed the circuit and the eye now works.  I  left the new switch in since it works just as well as the original.
